answer: Issue two invites per identity, refuse the third. Void the round when three of five graders share a host. Vest rewards across 100 epochs so a farm cannot sell what it has not earned. A recruit that fails an audit burns the inviter's next quota, so each fake account costs a real slot on the tree. The invite graph is the crystal: a comet of new identities shows there first, and the river behind it is the path auditors walk.
